integrity: The infinite-family result rests on an analytic proof; a standalone exact-rational finite-case test is corroborating evidence, not certification. The publication-priority assessment retains potential general stochastic-order/rearrangement antecedents; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-horizon terminal generation of a single-type Galton-Watson early-epidemic approximation; fixed independent potential-contact law and independently thinned potential transmissions; strictly positive generation-dependent transmissibilities; finite positive offspring mean and finite second moment. Does not cover cumulative infections, depleted networks, irreversible protection or adaptive policies.
title: Convex-order rearrangement of finite-generation epidemic risk under temporary transmission controls
